scenario: Anonymous requests a client, job, invoice, PDF or private file endpoint
observed: API anonymous CRM/job/quote/invoice/PDF/session requests return 401 and no-store; browser anonymous task/attachment denied.

scenario: Substitute an attachment ID from a different enquiry
observed: Actual authenticated forged enquiry-parent attachment request returns 404.

scenario: Request draft or archived project media, including resize URLs
observed: Archived/withdrawn project original and resize requests deny at both origins; private and withdrawn product media deny.

scenario: Submit a cookie-authenticated mutation from an untrusted or missing Origin
observed: Missing and foreign Origin mutations return 403 without an accepted task mutation.

scenario: Two concurrent issue requests followed by a retry after response loss
observed: Concurrent issuance replays one number/checksum/artifact; atomic sequence and stored-byte identity are asserted.

scenario: Save a draft concurrently with issuance
observed: Concurrent delayed draft save/issue resolves through locking or explicit re-review; post-issue stale save cannot change stored bytes.

scenario: Concurrent partial payments together exceed the remaining balance
observed: Concurrent payments that exceed the remaining exact decimal balance cannot both commit.

scenario: Retry the same payment after response loss
observed: Same scoped payment key returns the original identity; changed payload conflicts.

scenario: Edit client, catalogue and bank settings after invoice issuance
observed: After client, catalogue and bank edits, actual authenticated PDF download matches original bytes; checksum/number/total unchanged.

scenario: Preview and issue a short bilingual invoice
observed: Draft/final bilingual PDFs extract DE then EN with equal finances; missing translation policy is explicit.

scenario: Use long German text and one exceptionally long invoice line
observed: Long German and exceptionally long descriptions paginate; repeated headers and footer bounds are asserted.

scenario: Deploy the German-first renderer with historical issued PDFs
observed: All 23 migrations preserve the synthetic historical version-2 PDF bytes/checksum/number/version/sequence. New renderer is version 3.

scenario: Issue with unconfirmed tax settings or missing required translations
observed: Unknown tax or missing required German copy rejects issuance without a legal number; VAT ID cannot substitute tax choice.

scenario: Upload a spoofed image signature or excessive pixel dimensions
observed: Spoofed signatures, unsupported/corrupt images and excessive decoded dimensions reject; accepted images are re-encoded/metadata-stripped.

scenario: Finalize another actor's reservation or an oversized stored object
observed: Wrong capability/purpose/expiry/repeated claims and changed-byte protection are exercised; stored reads are stat-bounded. Oversized stored-object injection and production provider identity are not separately exercised.

scenario: Put SQL and HTML payloads in messages, names, filters and filenames
observed: Actual HTML/SQL-like enquiry payload remains exact stored data and is escaped in server-rendered private inbox; parameterized search and image filename stripping are covered separately. An exhaustive browser payload matrix over every filter/name/file path is not claimed.

scenario: Restore an isolated database and matching object backup
observed: A separate final restore matches all 38 public-table row fingerprints and all indexes. Both local object roots restore 23 files with exact SHA-256 bytes; all 23 accepted media keys have restored bytes. Source was not overwritten; productionBackupVerified remains false.

scenario: Submit English, Ukrainian and Russian messages with newlines and emoji
observed: EN/UK/RU/DE newline/emoji/edge-space messages retain exact database text; private inbox renders original text, without automatic translation.

scenario: Upload three 5MiB photos, one 5MiB+1-byte file and a 15MiB+1-byte total
observed: Three real valid 5MiB PNGs process/finalize at 15MiB; 5MiB+1 and total 15MiB+1 metadata reject, one racing claim succeeds.

scenario: Select HEIC, a corrupt image and a large phone photo on weak network
observed: Unsupported HEIC/corrupt input has rejection guidance; bounded signature/decoder tests pass. Full weak-network phone/HEIC-conversion UX and production worker are unverified/unavailable.

scenario: Double-click Send and lose the acknowledgement response
observed: The real browser loses an actual persisted 201 photo acknowledgement, then retries the same receipt: one photo PUT, one enquiry, exact original text and private attachment. Concurrent server claim/idempotency tests separately pass.

scenario: Persist an enquiry but fail to send the acknowledgement email
observed: Persistence precedes receipt; durable acknowledgement reservation and unknown SMTP states are implemented. Tests use synthetic send callbacks/local disabled mail, not an end-to-end real acknowledgement SMTP sink failure.

scenario: SMTP accepts a reply but recording its result fails
observed: Synthetic SMTP acceptance followed by record callback failure yields RECORD_FAILED; retry neither sends nor records again. No real recipient mail was used.

scenario: Use the same email for a household or several company contacts
observed: Two actual API client creations with a shared household email persist separate IDs; bounded lookup returns both for deliberate review. No auto-merge.

scenario: Expire a session while editing a private draft
observed: Expired/revoked credentials cannot mutate; 401 feedback retains newer editor input. Full reauthentication and stale recheck from an actively edited browser draft across all retained editors is not exercised.

scenario: Edit the same draft in two browser tabs
observed: Stale catalogue/project/task/invoice/quote versions reject and several concurrent requests are tested. Two interactive browser tabs with unsaved editor recovery are not separately exercised.

scenario: Create clients, jobs and invoices concurrently at Berlin New Year
observed: Six concurrent allocations per scope on both sides of Berlin New Year remain unique in CUSTOMER/SERVICE_JOB/INVOICE; concurrent household API creation also succeeds.

scenario: Select FROM, PERCENTAGE or MONTHLY catalogue pricing
observed: FROM/PERCENTAGE/MONTHLY need explicit agreement; monthly also needs ordered period; decimal calculation never creates recurring charges.

scenario: Accept an old or expired quote revision and retry conversion
observed: Wrong/stale acceptance revision rejects; conversion/invoice retries bind one immutable exact revision. Past-expiry acceptance guard exists but an elapsed-time HTTP case is not separately executed.

scenario: Attach an invoice to a job belonging to another client
observed: Actual invoice PATCH attempting a different client/job pair returns INVALID_INVOICE_RELATIONSHIP and preserves its original client. Task wrong-client job relations also reject in the database suite.
evidence: tests/rebuild-integration.test.ts; invoice and business relation guards

scenario: Rename a published project slug several times
observed: Actual published project renamed twice; both prior slugs return one-hop 308 to final canonical. Product aliases/withdrawal also exercised.

scenario: Use a missing translation or a legacy ua language alias
observed: Metadata includes only actual translated project/product counterparts; six locales and uk are retained, missing equivalents go to catalogue. Full legacy ua HTTP redirect/SEO matrix is not separately exercised.

scenario: Inspect the footer on desktop, tablet, phone and at 200% zoom
observed: Five real footer columns/asserted sections at seven widths; production screenshots and 720px zoom-equivalent reflow pass. Actual browser 200% zoom/social-link/content manual review is not certified.

scenario: Open, scroll and close the phone menu using keyboard and navigation
observed: Native phone menu opens below header and Escape restores trigger focus; source implements scroll lock/focus loop. Full scroll/Tab/navigation assistive-technology sequence remains manual.

scenario: Compare an empty list with a database outage
observed: Unit/handler tests distinguish successful empty, failed and malformed responses; actual UI has loading/error/retry states. No whole-server database-outage injection was performed.

scenario: Upload invalid STL, enormous mesh, archive or G-code
observed: Private model/file processing provider and bounded mesh validation worker are not configured/implemented as a production flow; STL/archive/G-code uploads remain unavailable.

scenario: Let provider restore history expire without an independent backup
observed: Production backup provider, independent retention and restore history are not provisioned or verified. A local synthetic restore does not satisfy this requirement.

scenario: Build both applications with deployed Node 24 and the actual lockfile
observed: Both apps build with Node 24.21.0 and the actual npm lockfile; final Control changes have a separate successful build. No hosted deployment assertion.

scenario: Create a portfolio draft from a completed job containing private notes
observed: Completed private job containing a unique confidential marker creates one replay-safe DRAFT from reviewed public text, no images/private notes copied, public detail 404.

scenario: Exercise rate limits across replicas and behind a shared public IP
observed: Shared database rate-counter concurrency and untrusted forwarded-IP fallback tests pass; actual distributed replicas/shared-NAT load testing and provider proxy verification remain release checks.

scenario: Open an unavailable template preview or purchase listing
observed: Unpublished/unavailable catalogue products expose factual unavailable/contact behavior, validated external URLs and no invented checkout. Actual external merchant availability/failure remains provider/content-dependent.

scenario: Schedule an appointment in an ambiguous or nonexistent local DST time
observed: Browser explicitly selects the second repeated Europe/Berlin 02:30 occurrence, persists 01:30Z and the IANA zone, then finds that same UTC instant in the calendar. Domain tests separately reject a nonexistent DST time.

scenario: Moderate a review with private photos and malicious text
observed: Reviews/moderation are disabled, with no invented customer evidence or public private-photo path. Enabling requires a separate implemented consent/moderation flow.

scenario: Report invoices issued in a different period from their payments, with mixed currencies
observed: Reports/expenses and profit are unavailable; dashboard balances use exact decimal totals per currency rather than inventing mixed-currency profit.

scenario: Export CSV containing formula payloads and a large file archive
observed: Actual CSV formula payload is neutralized; owner/session scope and expiry deny unauthorized downloads. The bounded 1000-row CSV export is real; large uploaded-file archive remains unavailable without a worker/inventory.

scenario: Compare 20% markup with 20% margin and convert grams to kilograms
observed: Decimal grams/kg cost conversion and distinct 20% markup versus 20% margin are asserted (18 versus 18.75 for base 15).

scenario: Use keyboard, screen reader, zoom and reduced-motion preferences
observed: Visible focus, menu Escape, labels and production accessibility-tree names/reduced motion/reflow are checked. Manual screen reader, full keyboard flow, real zoom and complete WCAG 2.2 AA audit remain outstanding.

scenario: Load realistic public media on a phone
observed: Production build on synthetic media: cold-browser-cache mobile 1.6Mbps/150ms/4x CPU sample LCP 1512ms, CLS 0, resource transfer 328716 bytes. One local sample; actual owner media, deployment latency and field INP/Core Web Vitals are unverified.

scenario: Observe Neon managed-auth tables while custom login is active
observed: Existing password plus secret-phrase login/session ownership is exercised; custom identity remains, no public registration or managed-auth migration introduced. No production auth table reads.

scenario: Inspect browser bundles, exports and diagnostic logs
observed: Exact known secret/synthetic credential scan has no matches in client bundles/implementation docs; safe lookup/export scope and redacted route errors tested. Unknown secret formats and complete production diagnostics are outside this local scan.

scenario: Request invoice cancellation when payments already exist
observed: Correction/cancellation is deliberately unavailable; no issued status rewrite or fictitious payment reversal. Approved accounting workflow/artifact/ledger semantics are a separate dependency.

scenario: Download an issued invoice whose original PDF bytes are missing
observed: Missing issued original PDF returns 409 ISSUED_PDF_MISSING and is never regenerated from mutable current data; test restores original synthetic bytes.
